title: Grateful Dead Live at Warfield Theater on 1982-02-17
source: Matrix of SBD (shnid=112408) and AUD (shnid=21916) by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut w/EQ > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging)

ai_review.summary: Matrix mix lifts an average three‑star show, with rousing Minglewood > Sugaree opening and solid second‑set highlights despite thin audience sound.
ai_review.review: The performance is judged as an "average" three‑star concert – strong openings like Minglewood > Sugaree and a rare Women Are Smarter close, plus a decent second set featuring Scarlet > Fire > Estimated Prophet, The Wheel and Sugar Magnolia. The matrix blend of board and audience (though the crowd track is thin) is praised for its clean mix and thoughtful fades, turning an otherwise modest show into something more listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is average (≈3 stars) while the recording mix is notably good; weighted combination yields a mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience track described as very thin, board less so, but Hunter's matrix mixing adds clarity, smooth crowd fades and extra bass/reverb that improve the overall listening experience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Opening set rousing with strong transitions; second set flows well through a tight sequence (Scarlet > Fire > Estimated > Eyes) into The Wheel, though some moments (e.g., Sugar Magnolia) are noted as slightly sloppy.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bob's vocal on On The Road Again described as "slightly silly" and his improvisational shout‑outs in Estimated Prophet ("Ha Haaas") called over the top.
